NETWORK BOUNDARY - edge device may remain offline for hours/days; all local operations must continue safely
RASPBERRY PI / LINUX EDGE DEVICE - Python + PyQt + systemd + SQLite
Device UI and normal operational workflow
Writes device logs / measurements to local
Prefer permission checks over scattering role-name checks throughout UI.
B. edge-sync.service - Always-running Python systemd service
Runs at boot, when connectivity returns,
Calls RBAC Sync API over HTTPS
Reads telemetry SQLite in read-only mode
Finds rows newer than durable checkpoint
Sends through azure-iot-device to IoT Hub
Linux lifecycle: systemctl enable/start/restart edge-sync | journald logs | dedicated least-privilege user
C. Local SQLite Persistence - Offline System of Record
Never store Entra passwords. Store only app authorization cache + securely derived offline credential verifier.
